definition: A process or set of rules to be followed in calculations.

definition: A structured set of data held in a computer.

definition: A group of two or more computer systems linked together.

definition: A device or program enabling a user to communicate with a computer.

definition: The use of largely automatic equipment in a system of operation.

definition: The programs and other operating information used by a computer.
exampleSentence: Engineers deployed the latest software patch across cloud clusters.

definition: A device that detects or measures a physical property.

definition: The machines, wiring, and other physical components of a computer.

definition: A thing made or adapted for a particular purpose, especially a mechanical part.
exampleSentence: Students can synchronize learning flashcards across all personal devices.

definition: A network of remote servers hosted on the Internet to store data.
